resources.string: Your phone may stop Stay Focused in the background to save battery, which pauses your blocks. Follow these steps for your phone.
See steps for your phone on dontkillmyapp.com

string-array.name: sf_battery_steps_xiaomi
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Apps, then Manage apps, then Stay Focused.
Turn on Autostart.
Tap Battery saver and choose No restrictions.
In Recent apps, lock Stay Focused so it is not cleared.

string-array.name: sf_battery_steps_oppo
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Battery, then Stay Focused.
Allow background activity and allow auto launch.
In Recent apps, lock Stay Focused so it is not cleared.

string-array.name: sf_battery_steps_vivo
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Battery, then Background power consumption.
Choose Stay Focused and allow high background power use.
Allow Autostart for Stay Focused in Settings, then Apps.

string-array.name: sf_battery_steps_samsung
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Battery, then Background usage limits.
Remove Stay Focused from Sleeping apps and Deep sleeping apps.
Open Settings, then Apps, then Stay Focused, then Battery, and choose Unrestricted.

string-array.name: sf_battery_steps_oneplus
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Battery, then Battery optimization.
Choose Stay Focused and select Don\'t optimize.
In Recent apps, lock Stay Focused so it is not cleared.

string-array.name: sf_battery_steps_huawei
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Battery, then App launch.
Turn off Manage automatically for Stay Focused.
Turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.

string-array.name: sf_battery_steps_default
string-array.item: Open the battery settings below.
Find Stay Focused and choose Don\'t optimize or Unrestricted.
If your phone has an autostart or background-activity setting, allow it for Stay Focused.
